AI Layoffs Mount Across Tech Sector Amid SaaS Market Downturn: Report

Artificial intelligence-driven layoffs are accelerating across the global and Israeli software sectors as companies restructure their operations around automation. According to a Jerusalem Post report, firms like monday.com, Wix, and major tech giants are cutting jobs to fund AI investments.
